text:
maria_onboard: Heads up — new signup AtlasEdge (org=org_9876) completed SSO and project creation but no API key showed up in project 'atlas-edge-prod'. Console shows 'claim: pending' and provisioner logs show repeated 504s. Anyone seen this pattern before?

sara_support: Can you paste the org id + the provisioning claim id? Also a quick screenshot of the Projects view would help.

maria_onboard: org=org_9876 claim=claim_0x7f8. Tail of provisioner log attached:```[2026-03-16T20:01:12Z] POST /claims -> 504 gateway timeout retry=3
[2026-03-16T20:01:15Z] claim claim_0x7f8 created in staging queue but no sync to project
``` Console API returns `404 Key not found` for `GET /v1/projects/atlas-edge-prod/keys`. Customer can't make their first API calls.

provisioner-bot: Provisioner: claim_0x7f8 status=queued, attempts=3, last_error='upstream_timeout', assigned_worker=eu-west-1-provisioner-2

ben_platform: Likely an event-delivery race between the OIDC webhook and the provisioner. Quick workaround: manual sync command: `rbwctl provision sync-claim --org org_9876 --claim claim_0x7f8` (infra role required). I can run it if you want.

sara_support: @ben_platform please run it; customer is blocked on first calls. ETA? :pray:

ben_platform: Running now... output:```sync started
fetching claim claim_0x7f8...
claim mapped to project atlas-edge-prod
creating key...
key created: key_ABC123
sync complete
``` Key should show up in the Console in ~30s.

maria_onboard: Confirmed — key is visible in the project and the customer made a successful test call. Thanks! :raised_hands:

alex_eng_oncall: Adding follow-up: root cause was a transient 504 from our SSO connector which caused the claim to be queued instead of processed synchronously. I'll open infra ticket infra#3782 to add retries + better alerting when claims remain queued >5m.

ben_platform: Also adding a short-term monitor: alert when provisioner attempts >2 AND last_error contains 'upstream_timeout' for >2m. That should surface these earlier.

sara_support: Closing for now; will re-open if it reoccurs. Logging as Zendesk #ZD-3241 and tagging customer success. :white_check_mark:
